cw_sr_control_return = {
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — GC emergency space quarantine.
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_emergency_disabled } }

if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_emergency_disabled } is_ai = no IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized check_variable = { cw_sr_control_parent > 0 } check_variable = { cw_sr_control_parent < 85 } }
set_variable = { cw_sr_selected = cw_sr_control_parent }
set_variable = { cw_sr_control_parent = 0 }
cw_sr_selected_map = yes
set_variable = { cw_sr_tab = 8 }
}
}
